WITH web_v1 AS (
    SELECT 
        ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_date,
        SUM(ws_sales_price) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ws_item_sk 
            ORDER BY d_date 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cume_sales
    FROM 
        web_sales
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1223
        AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
store_v1 AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d_date,
        SUM(ss_sales_price) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ss_item_sk 
            ORDER BY d_date 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cume_sales
    FROM 
        store_sales
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1223
        AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(w.item_sk, s.item_sk) AS item_sk,
    COALESCE(w.d_date, s.d_date) AS d_date,
    w.cume_sales AS web_sales,
    s.cume_sales AS store_sales,
    MAX(w.cume_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(w.item_sk, s.item_sk) ORDER BY COALESCE(w.d_date, s.d_date)) AS web_cumulative,
    MAX(s.cume_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(w.item_sk, s.item_sk) ORDER BY COALESCE(w.d_date, s.d_date)) AS store_cumulative
FROM 
    web_v1 w
LEFT JOIN 
    store_v1 s 
    ON w.item_sk = s.item_sk 
    AND w.d_date = s.d_date
WHERE 
    MAX(w.cume_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(w.item_sk, s.item_sk) ORDER BY COALESCE(w.d_date, s.d_date)) > 
    MAX(s.cume_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(w.item_sk, s.item_sk) ORDER BY COALESCE(w.d_date, s.d_date))
ORDER BY 
    item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
